about: Check-off edits for recurring tasks (#1036). Run by task-recurrence.test.ts and, once mirrored, by the zn CLI's Go tests. `expected: null` means the task is not an open recurring one and the caller toggles it as usual.

cases.name: weekly from its due date, the record drops @repeat and @remind
cases.expected:
- [ ] Water the plants @repeat:weekly due:2026-11-08 @remind:9am
- [x] Water the plants due:2026-11-01

cases.name: a late finish skips the missed occurrences
an early finish goes one interval past the due date
no due date counts from today and writes one
a daily note's date stands in for a missing due
frontmatter due beats the daily note's date
cases.expected:
---
due: 2026-10-31
---
- [ ] Pay invoice @repeat:monthly due:2026-11-30
- [x] Pay invoice

cases.name: monthly clamps to the month's last day
yearly across a leap day
cases.expected:
- [ ] Renew passport @repeat:yearly due:2029-02-28
- [x] Renew passport due:2028-02-29

cases.name: weekday lists pick the next listed day
weekdays skip the weekend
after- counts from the day it is finished
cases.expected:
- [ ] Water the fern @repeat:after-3d due:2026-11-04
- [x] Water the fern due:2026-10-20

cases.name: the subtree repeats unticked; the record keeps its ticks and cancels what was left open
cases.body:
## Chores
- [ ] Weekly review @repeat:fri due:2026-10-30
  - [x] Inbox zero
  - [ ] Plan the week
  - [/] Draft the update
    - [ ] Nested open
  - [-] Calendar
  - [>] Moved [[Elsewhere]]
  notes stay
- [ ] Other
cases.expected:
## Chores
- [ ] Weekly review @repeat:fri due:2026-11-06
  - [ ] Inbox zero
  - [ ] Plan the week
  - [ ] Draft the update
    - [ ] Nested open
  - [ ] Calendar
  - [ ] Moved [[Elsewhere]]
  notes stay
- [x] Weekly review due:2026-10-30
  - [x] Inbox zero
  - [-] Plan the week
  - [-] Draft the update
    - [-] Nested open
  - [-] Calendar
  - [>] Moved [[Elsewhere]]
  notes stay
- [ ] Other

cases.name: in progress finishes, the next one starts open; @waiting and @status do not carry
cases.expected:
- [ ] Ship it !high @repeat:weekly due:2026-11-08 #work
- [x] Ship it !high due:2026-11-01 @status:doing @waiting #work

cases.name: skip writes a cancelled record
cases.body:
- [ ] Water the plants @repeat:weekly due:2026-11-01
  - [ ] Check the soil
cases.expected:
- [ ] Water the plants @repeat:weekly due:2026-11-08
  - [ ] Check the soil
- [-] Water the plants due:2026-11-01
  - [-] Check the soil

cases.name: numbered, quoted and indented tasks keep their prefix
the index counts like the parser, past fenced code
cases.body:
```
- [ ] not a task @repeat:daily
```
- [ ] first
- [ ] second @repeat:daily due:2026-11-01
cases.expected:
```
- [ ] not a task @repeat:daily
```
- [ ] first
- [ ] second @repeat:daily due:2026-11-02
- [x] second due:2026-11-01

cases.name: a spaced due token is replaced as one
cases.expected:
- [ ] Spaced @repeat:daily due:2026-11-02 tail
- [x] Spaced due: 2026-11-01 tail

cases.name: CRLF notes keep their endings
cases.expected:
- [ ] Win @repeat:daily due:2026-11-02
  - [ ] sub
- [x] Win due:2026-11-01
  - [-] sub
- [ ] after

cases.name: the rule is case-insensitive
an unknown rule is an ordinary task
a done task does not repeat again
cancelled and forwarded tasks do not repeat
a task without a rule is ordinary
